newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia CPI rises 21.5 pct in Sept vs August.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia CPI rises 21.5 pct in Sept vs August.

text.p: Mongolia's consumer price inflation rose 21.5 percent in September from August, official statistics showed on Thursday.
The State Statistics Bulletin showed consumer price inflation at the end of September was 42.7 percent higher than at the beginning of this year.
Prices of 205 services and items rose 55.7 percent in September from January, the state statistics bureau said. Of these, rent, heating and electricity prices rose 1.6 to 4.2 times, it added.
Mongolia liberalised energy prices in early September.
